nodes.npcLine: Welcome to the tourist office! Where are you going to travel?

playerOptions.text: I am going to visit the museum and the lake.
Can you give me a map, please?

nodes.npcLine: Excellent choices. You are going to discover the best of COSY Town.

playerOptions.text: I am going to start my journey today.

nodes.npcLine: Of course. Here is a map of COSY Town and the surrounding world.

playerOptions.text: Thank you. I am going to plan my route.
